巴渠 is the single regional name Baqu, as the chapter also renders it in later passages.

The mountain was precipitous on all four sides, suitable for attack and defense; before the fort was finished, the Song Kui Circuit investigating commissioner Zheng Zifa said: 'Panlong is the throat of Kui; if the enemy holds it, Kui will be hard to defend—this is ground that must be contested.'"
